details.description:
At 536 PM CDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm near
Berlin, or 8 miles southeast of Hamburg, moving southeast at 15 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and pea size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Hamburg, Wilmot, Parkdale, Jones, and Berlin.

At 536 PM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 8 miles southeast of
Ericson, or 20 miles east of Ord, moving southeast at 15 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to
roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Greeley and Spalding.

At 335 PM MST, radar indicated strong thunderstorms were located near
Cibeque Falls, or 28 miles north of Globe, moving southwest at 10
mph.

Conditions are becoming more favorable for the development of
additional thunderstorms. Some storms may become strong to severe.

Winds in excess of 40 mph and pea size hail will be possible.

Locations impacted include...
Cibeque Falls.

This includes US Highway 60 between mile markers 279 and 295.

Frequent cloud to ground lightning is occurring with this storm.
Lightning can strike 10 miles away from a thunderstorm. Seek a safe
shelter inside a building or vehicle.

events.title: Heat Advisory
events.location: Western Arctic Plains; Central Arctic Plains

details.description:
* WHAT...Hot temperatures as high as 85 degrees expected.

* WHERE...Central and Western Arctic Plains.

* WHEN...Until midnight AKDT Thursday night.

* IMPACTS...Individuals not accustomed to these unusually hot
temperatures for this region may experience heat related illnesses.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...High temperatures up to 85 degrees during the
afternoons and evenings. The warmest temperatures are expected
between 4 PM and 11 PM AKDT.

The storm which prompted the warning has weakened below severe
limits, and no longer poses an immediate threat to life or property.
Therefore, the warning will be allowed to expire.  However, gusty
winds are still possible with this thunderstorm.
